entry.title: New: dshmath-manim
entry.summary: Manim CE based math animation plugin: 6 built-in templates (function/derivative/integral/geometry/polar/3D surface) plus a zero-code skill pack (math-animation / manim-codegen) - natural language to animated math videos, with AST static security validation. Exact install spec: github:phelpsyacht/dshmath-manim. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
